subject: 1X & Boston Dynamics - how we helped robotics teams move beyond CVAT
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Adam at Actuate, and he mentioned you currently insource labelling
due to the US-based workforce requirement and use 2D tools like CVAT.

We've onboarded 1X last week (alongside Boston Dynamics earlier this year)
to help their perception teams move past CVAT's limitations i.e.
inefficiencies of splitting out frames and struggling with rich captions.
We've allowed
them to keep control of their data while improving throughput and label
quality.

I'd like to show you our approach to saving them money while their models
achieve incremental gains. Even if you're continuing to insource, it might
give you a few ideas for scaling your perception and evaluation workflows.

Does next week work? We're pretty free in the afternoons.

subject: 1X, Atlas & PI's solution for VLA captioning
text:
Dear [NAME]. Bae,

I recently learned about [COMPANY]'s pioneering work on the Robotics
Foundation Model and your vision for advancing Physical AI. I was impressed
by the team's achievements in integrating multimodal intelligence.

At Encord, we have built a data management and annotation platform that
supports leading robotics and embodied AI teams in optimizing their model
training pipelines - including organizations such as 1X, the Atlas group
from Boston Dynamics, and Physical Intelligence. Our solutions help teams
efficiently manage and label complex multimodal data used in
vision-language-action (VLA) and policy learning models.

Given the strong alignment between [COMPANY]'s research direction and our
recent collaborations, I would be honored to have a short discussion to
exchange ideas and explore potential areas of collaboration.

Would it be convenient for you to have a short virtual meeting next week?
Ideally in the afternoon.

subject: Coffee @ Ray Summit?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Looking forward to your talk on LLM post-training at Ray Summit!

We work with Synthesia and Mirage (Captions) whom, similar to Character.AI,
focus on making human to AI communications more natural. I saw your
multimodal team recently released Ovi for audio & video generation - we're
familiar with SFT and RLHF on those types of model outputs.

For context - we focus on improving training data quality - annotation
pipeline automation & flexible UI for captioning and preference ranking
tasks as well. To help ML teams like yours accelerate model development
with cleaner data.

We'll be at Ray Summit (Nov 3-5) - would you be open to a quick coffee or
hallway chat?
